name: Necromancer Bone Legion raises Lichfrost damage and Runic Power generation (#1281)
contract: Bone Legion is a two-rank Rime talent (CharacterAdvancement 33725, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 60, TalentEssenceCost 1; RankSpell 707006 and 707881, SpellFamilyName 29) whose description reads 'Increases the damage of Lichfrost by $s1% and its Runic Power generated by $s2%.' Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 9/19 + DieSides 1 = 10%/20%, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x8000000): every Lichfrost rank (801722, 501969-501980). Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2), BasePoints 24/49 + DieSides 1 = 25%/50%, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x40): Lichfrost's Runic Power helper 804112 (family flags 0, 0x100000, 0x40), which Lichfrost effect 1 triggers and whose effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE Runic Power, BasePoints 61 + DieSides 31 = 62-92 (6.2-9.2 Runic Power; the only other 0x40 holder, Ice Barrage damage 803779, has no effect 2). Neither effect is aura 42/354, so the Necromancer load contract leaves both intact, and both are native: Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone multiplies done damage by SPELLMOD_DAMAGE and SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue applies SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 to 804112's energize. Expected: rank 1 multiplies Lichfrost's done damage by 1.10 and the helper's effect 2 by 1.25; rank 2 by 1.20 and 1.50, so a real Lichfrost cast that generates 62-92 Runic Power without the talent generates 93-138 with rank 2. Spell 500980, also named Bone Legion, is a separate description-less record (aura 42 to 500803 Skeletal Charge, ProcFlags 0, no CharacterAdvancement row) and is not a rank of this talent.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
CONTROL: the Runic Power helper is unmodified without the talent
CONTROL: an untalented Lichfrost generates 6.2-9.2 Runic Power
Rank 1 raises the helper's Runic Power effect by 25%
Rank 2 raises the helper's Runic Power effect by 50%
DISCRIMINATING: a rank 2 Lichfrost generates 9.3-13.8 Runic Power
